records.groupTitle: Property Rental Index, Office In Central Region By Locality, (4th Quarter 1998 = 100)
records.title: Property Rental Index, Office In Central Region By Locality, (4th Quarter 1998 = 100), Quarterly
records.footnote: Data refer to properties owned by the private sector.  The rental index is computed based on fixed weights before 4th Quarter 1998.  The weights used to compute the index are updated every quarter from 4th Quarter 1998.  Rental indices are computed from data on rentals provided by the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS).
